data_description.api_key: The AuthenticationSecret of the frame, if it has one.
data_description.url: Address of the frame, such as http://192.168.1.166:8080.

user.description: The frame must run the ImmichFrame fork, which adds the API this integration uses.

cannot_connect.message: The frame could not be reached.

data_description.sensors: A climate entity shows its current temperature, anything else its state. The emoji goes before the value.

show_notification.description: Shows a message on top of the slideshow, above the ones already shown, with an optional link and end. The frame keeps the latest three.

duration.description: Minutes before the notification hides itself. Empty or 0 keeps it until newer ones push it out.
duration.name: Duration

link.description: Opened on tap: /path opens that Home Assistant view, homeassistant:// and https:// links are opened as they are.
link.name: Link

message.description: Text to show. A message already shown moves back to the top. An empty message clears the tagged notification, or all of them.
message.name: Message

tag.description: Identifies the notification, as on a phone: a new message with the same tag replaces it, an empty message with it clears it alone.
tag.name: Tag

show_notification.name: Show notification
